article.title: Probate or administration, with will annexed, subject to exception.
article.content: Whenever the nature of the case requires that an exception be made, probate of a will, or letters of administration with the will annexed, shall be granted subject to such exception.
article.html:
255Probate or administration, with will annexed, subject to exception.

Section 255 · Part IX · Chapter II · page 74 of the Act

Whenever the nature of the case requires that an exception be made, probate of a will, or letters of administration with the will annexed, shall be granted subject to such exception.
